contexts.text: The upright are first taken to paradisiacal things...
Isles = the upright nations outside the Church... who have lived in simplicity and probity.
According to their probity. Signified.
The angelic Society which accords with (their) piety, probity, etc.
A certain one who had seemed to himself greater and wiser than others; but was otherwise upright.
Infants, upright children, and the simple in heart.
Sheep (correspond to) probity, etc.
The infants who are more upright than others...
The upright are first remitted into the life they had in the world...
They have removed the upright... not by vituperating them, because probity defends itself; but in other ways. Explained. SE 1809.
Those who are hereditarily mild and upright...
Upright Spirits of the thymus gland. Described.
For the evil want to seem upright and zealous; and... are more strongly excited (to perform uses) than the upright.
He thinks that the upright would be more happy in the world than the wicked.

Hence the wicked appear to be more glad and glorious than the upright. But the glorying and gladness of the wicked are external, and in the other life are turned into infernal unhappiness; but (those) of the upright are internal, which remain, and become heavenly happiness.

In eminence and opulence there is worldly but not eternal felicity; hence they are the portion of both the bad and the good; and if not of the latter, it is lest they by such things should be turned away from good.
The infestation of the upright (there) by falsities. Treated of.(The upright are mentioned all through the account of the sons of Israel in Egypt.)
Fear is a common bond, with both the upright and the evil; but with the upright it is an internal fear...
How the case is with the evil who (there) infest the upright.
Lest they should seduce the simple upright Spirits, with whom they have communication through truths.
Whence is the probity (of the inhabitants of Jupiter).
(The Spirits of Saturn) are upright and modest...
According to the life of probity and obedience towards parents and magistrates...
(The Spirits of the Third Earth) are upright, so that they may be called probities. Described.
Calvin is upright... SE 6041. ConvCalvin 6.
The virtues which pertain to the moral wisdom of the men are called probity, etc.
A man who is honourable, upright, pious, and religious...
Within, there are inseminated by the Lord, mercy, charity, probity, piety, justice...
Concerning probity from fear.

True probity and goodness are of the Lord, and are manifested by this: that he wills well to all. (The others) can be kept in the probity of fear; nay, this probity can be increased even to the adoring of the Lord; but, as soon as they are beyond fear, they return to wickedness.
Evil Spirits can be kept in... a sphere of probity...
Yet the sphere of probity and goodness comes from the Lord...
On the sphere of the opinion of probity.
The sphere of this dignity is so conjoined with that of probity and goodness...
How the evil states of the upright return in the other life. Explained.
Augustus was an upright man...
They make nothing of a life of probity.
On those who have acquired reputation by external probity.
They had been sensuous in the world, yet upright...
Two kinds of men upon whom the Judgment is executed; one consists of the upright, the other of the wicked. The upright are Angels in the Ultimate Heaven, most of whom are simple...
